task: A customer named Renee emailed saying she was charged twice for her order #88217 on the same day, and she's upset. Write a reply apologizing, confirming we found the duplicate charge from a payment retry, and saying the extra $64.20 will be refunded to her Visa within 3-5 business days. Keep it empathetic and under 150 words.
rewrite:
```
ambition:     A top support lead opens with the fix, not the apology, then owns the error plainly with no blame on Renee and no hedging. They explain the retry in one plain phrase instead of saying "payment retry" as jargon, and they tell her what to expect on her Visa statement so she doesn't have to write back to ask.
agency:       The rawest material is Renee's own email (her wording and how upset she is) and the processor record showing both charges on #88217. Neither is in reach here, so assume the facts as given: order #88217, two charges the same day from a retry, $64.20 extra, Visa, 3-5 business days.
acceleration: Use the HEARD pattern (hear, empathize, apologize, resolve, diagnose) in plain, warm language, with one short paragraph per beat and no template phrasing like "we apologize for any inconvenience."
accuracy:     Before sending, check #88217, $64.20, Visa, and "3-5 business days" against the processor's refund record. Run a word count to confirm it is under 150. Nothing in the model can verify the refund was actually issued, so the processor record is the closest proxy.
```

answers.plain:
**Subject:** Your duplicate charge on order #88217 has been resolved

Hi Renee,

I'm so sorry about the double charge on your order #88217. I completely understand how frustrating and worrying that must have been, and I apologize for the stress it caused.

I've looked into it and confirmed what happened: a payment retry on our end caused your card to be charged twice on the same day. The duplicate was our error, not yours.

The extra $64.20 will be refunded to your Visa within 3–5 business days. You don't need to do anything on your side.

If the refund hasn't appeared after that time, please reply to this email and I'll look into it right away.

Thank you for your patience, and again, I'm sorry for the trouble.

Warm regards,
[Your name]
[Company name] Customer Support
